Note that DOC-2 reconciles *income from operations*, a different measure, and is not additive to the net income build; the non-GAAP net income figure derives solely from DOC-1.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| GAAP net income [DOC-1] | $1,748 |

| Severance costs [DOC-1] | +74 |
| Legal settlements [DOC-1] | +0 |
